summary: CAIR Action endorsed Rod Daus-Magbual for his Daly City council bid and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally, both groups that assess candidates on Gaza ceasefire and human-rights positions. CAIR-SFBA's tracker records that he supported a local ceasefire resolution in June 2024. His campaign platform addresses housing, immigration, and public safety without taking a direct position on Israel-Palestine policy.
